Grown-up notes ↗
A little space for big thinking.

A place to explore together

This small prototype notices how you solve a few problems. It does not assign a grade, diagnose a difficulty, or decide class placement.

Progress stays in this browser on this device. You can turn saved progress off in Grown-up notes. There are no ads, analytics, recordings, or AI conversations. Downloaded notes are yours to keep. Hosting still processes ordinary page requests.

The grown-up view is an ordinary tab, not a password-protected area. Use the site together.
